points.description: Convolutional layer(s): kernels/filters convolve over the input image to extract features (feature maps). Accept 'feature extraction using filters'.

levels.says: Mentions a convolutional layer but without kernels/filters or feature extraction.

points.description: Activation layer, e.g. ReLU (non-linearity), after convolution. Naming ReLU or another named non-linear activation is acceptable.
Pooling layer (max or average pooling) that downsamples/reduces spatial size of feature maps.
One or more fully connected (dense) layers, followed by an output/softmax (classification) layer.

levels.says: Mentions only fully connected layers or only softmax/output layer, not both.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming the main layers in order: convolution (with kernels), activation (ReLU), pooling, fully connected then softmax. Part marks when a layer is named without its key detail, or when only one of FC/softmax is given. No marks for generic statements about neural networks without CNN layers.
